cases.name: Deidre Anita Waters
cases.about: She worked at an employers home as a daycare worker.
cases.narrative: The autopsy on Deidre's body disclosed twenty-four significant wounds, most of which were slash wounds. Two of the wounds were capable of causing death: a deep slashing wound on her neck which cut her carotid artery, and a penetrating wound on her anterior chest which went into her right lung.

cases.name: Tamra "Tammy" Ann Gibson
cases.about: Her obituary said, "A loving mother and grandmother, Tammy loved spending time with her granddaughters, Luna and Eliza, baking cookies, crafting, playing board games and taking walks outside. She loved an opportunity to watch a good movie, read a thrilling book or commune over a home cooked meal. Tammy was a fun and loving free-spirit with a big heart and tender smile. She enjoyed helping others in times of need."
